ValidationRule.description: This rule is fired when value of status is not changed from "In progress" to "On Hold - Customer" or "On Hold - Internal" .
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , OR( AND(ISNEW(), OR(ISPICKVAL( Status, "On Hold - Internal") , ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Customer") )), AND(ISCHANGED( Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status ), "In Progress")), OR(ISPICKVAL( Status, "On Hold - Internal") , ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Customer") ) )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "On Hold – Internal" or "On Hold - Customer" can be changed from "In Progress".
